* '''Playtest''' (this page, 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-kaminoclonetrainingcenter-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/kaminoclonetrainingcenter.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “If you control, your non-unique clone troopers are power and forfeit +1.” Dark Side: “Fetts deploy -1 here.”
* '''Original''' ([[Kamino: Clone Training Center]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-kaminoclonetrainingcenter-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/kaminoclonetrainingcenter.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “While you control, your non-unique clone troopers are power and forfeit +1.” Dark Side: “Fetts deploy -1 here.” '''What changed:''' before release: Light Side “If you control” became “While you control”; the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; re-rendered with sharper graphics; the image is now stored as a landscape site card (it was stored upright on 1 August).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kamino: Clone Training Center (Errata)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-kaminoclonetrainingcenter.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/kaminoclonetrainingcenter.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “While you control, your non-unique clone troopers are power and forfeit +1.” Dark Side: “Fetts deploy -1 here.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution (the credit line now reads “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
